name: InformationCallout
description: a callout box highlighting informational content
status: stable — exercised in composed page flows under e2e and axe, beyond the per-component checks
aria: `role="note"` -- identifies the content as a note or supplementary information
`aria-label={label}` -- provides an accessible name describing the type of callout (e.g., "Note", "Warning", "Tip")
keyboard: No keyboard interactions — this is a passive element
props: `label`: string (required) -- accessible name for the callout via `aria-label`
`...restProps`: unknown -- additional attributes spread onto the `<aside>` element
